files.description: This test file covers the photo gallery feature. It includes tests for verifying that images load correctly without broken links, that filtering by year works via the custom searchable-select widget, and that pagination (page size, First/Next/Last navigation, disabled states) works.

testContext: The tests rely on the following selectors: `.photo-grid` for the main gallery container, `.photo-card` for individual photo items, `.photo-date` for the card date, and role locators for buttons/links like `getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply Filters' })` and `getByRole('link', { name: 'Next ›' })`. IMPORTANT: every `<select class="searchable-select">` (e.g. `select#year-select`, `select#page-size`) is hidden (`display: none`) behind a custom widget inserted right after it; `locator.selectOption()` times out on them. Interact via `select#<id> + .searchable-select-wrapper`: click `.searchable-select-display`, then click the `.searchable-select-option` with the desired text. The page-size select's option VALUES are full URLs (`/?page=1&page-size=10&...`) and choosing one navigates via its onchange handler. Filter form submits GET with many params, so URL assertions should use regexes like /[?&]year=2014/ rather than exact query-string ordering. The tests assume the seeded test data spans multiple pages at page size 10 (14 photos seeded) and contains multiple years. Photo detail links point to /media/view/{id}; images are served from /media/{id} with data-fallback pointing at /placeholder.
explanation: 2026-07-01: Fixed after the JS testing migration. Native selects are now wrapped by the searchable-select component, so `selectOption()` on `select#year-select` / `select#page-size` timed out (element not visible). Both interactions now go through the custom widget (`.searchable-select-display` + `.searchable-select-option`), and exact URL glob waits were replaced with query-param regexes because the filter form serializes every filter field. All 3 tests pass against the isolated sandbox.
